disclaimer: Checklist built from a curated rule list, not legal advice. Confirm with a customs broker or the named authority before travel.

rules.title: Export licence for dual-use items leaving the EU
rules.summary: Items listed in Annex I of Regulation (EU) 2021/821 need an export licence to leave the EU. Thermal imaging cameras can fall under category 6A003, depending on their specifications. Annex I was replaced by Regulation (EU) 2025/2003, so classify against the current list.
rules.action: Ask the supplier for the ECCN / EU control classification of the exact model. If it is listed, apply to the Licensing Administration of the Czech Ministry of Industry and Trade (MPO).
rules.authority: Licensing Administration, Ministry of Industry and Trade (Licenční správa MPO)
rules.confidence: verified in law text, model-specific classification unknown

rules.title: Licence processing time and fee
rules.summary: A consultancy reports an MPO dual-use export licence fee of CZK 500 and about 30 days of processing.
rules.action: Plan the purchase so the licence can arrive before departure, or pick a model the supplier confirms is not listed.

rules.title: Export customs declaration at the EU exit point
rules.summary: Goods leaving the EU are declared for export. The driver carries the invoice and packing list so the EU exit office can confirm exit.
rules.action: Get a commercial invoice and packing list from every supplier, with item names, quantities, values and the buyer's details.
rules.confidence: general EU customs practice, confirm thresholds with a broker

rules.title: Humanitarian aid declaration on entry to Ukraine
rules.summary: Under Cabinet Resolution 953 (5 Sep 2023) humanitarian aid passes the border with a declaration filled in by the person transporting the goods, registered with a unique aid code.
rules.action: The receiving organisation registers the aid and gives the driver the declaration and code before departure.
rules.authority: Ministry of Social Policy of Ukraine, State Customs Service
rules.confidence: official announcements from 2023, check for later amendments

rules.title: End-user letter for thermal imagers and night vision
rules.summary: A 2022 procedure let thermal imagers, night vision devices and drones enter with a letter of guarantee from the end user. Whether it still applies after Resolution 953 is not confirmed.
rules.action: Ask the receiving unit or organisation for a signed end-user letter naming the items and serial numbers.

rules.title: Medical device documents
rules.summary: Tourniquets and first-aid kits are medical devices in the EU. A CE marking and the supplier's declaration of conformity make customs and donor checks easier.
rules.action: Ask the supplier for the CE declaration of conformity and batch or lot numbers.

rules.title: Driver and vehicle documents for own transport
rules.summary: With the organisation's own van the driver needs the vehicle registration, green card insurance valid in Ukraine and a power of attorney if the van is not registered to the driver.
rules.action: Check that the green card covers Ukraine and prepare a power of attorney for the driver.
